detail.longDescription: Recently, I have been working on my old-school style plain HTML and CSS forum project[1] based on # django and # python a lot. I still need to find a good way to specify # docker logs to rotate after specifiable time, and not only when they reach some file size. This is important for data protection / privacy statements shown on their pages when one hosts the forum. Does anyone know how to get time-based log rotation for a docker container / docker compose service? [1]: https:// codeberg.org/ZelphirKaltstahl/ xiaolong-forum
